title: Evaluation of an arithmetic circuit
statement: Let $F$ be a commutative ring, let $\iota$ be an input-index type, and assign a value in $F$ to each input index. The value of a circuit is obtained by interpreting input wires by this assignment, constants by their given values, addition and multiplication gates by the ring operations, and scalar multiplication by multiplication by its public coefficient.
